evidence.quote: Dragon’s Bane, Wind Mantle| Dragon’s Bane| Dragon’s Bane

subject: Final battles
text: The player can attempt the Final Battles at a lower level if feeling brave.

evidence.quote: You can attempt the Final Battles at a lower level if you are feeling brave.

subject: Rhone Monolith forest path to temple
text: From Rhone Monolith, go west across the bridges, follow the forest path west, southwest, south, southeast and east to its end, then north to a temple and enter it.

evidence.quote: From Rhone Monolith, travel west across the bridges, then follow the forest path west to its end, southwest, then south to the end, then southeast, and east to reach the end of the forest path. ... From there, go north to find a temple. Go into it.
